relatedSnapshot.title: Name 12 shifts when selecting trigger and action types
relatedSnapshot.description:
There is weird shifting/jittery behavior in the sidebar when selecting triggers and services/actions in the workflows builder.

The issue is most noticeable when clicking a specific action type. See the attached screen recording for an example.

## Implementation Plan (Name 13)

### Root Cause

The `StepCreationPanel` component uses `overflow-y-auto` on 6 scrollable content areas. When navigating between layers (e.g., service list → action detail), content height changes toggle the vertical scrollbar on/off, shifting content horizontally by \~15px.

### Fix

Apply the same pattern already used in `NodeConfigPanel` (`overflow-y-scroll` + `scrollbarGutter: 'stable'`) to all 6 scroll containers in `step-creation-panel.tsx`:

* TriggerTypesLayer (line 251)
* AppListLayer (line 319)
* AppTriggerDetailLayer (line 405)
* ActionServicesLayer (line 504)
* ActionServiceDetailLayer (line 587)
* trigger-config layer (line 810)

### Affected Files

* `components/workflows/builder/step-creation-panel.tsx` — change 6 `overflow-y-auto` divs to `overflow-y-scroll` + `style={{ scrollbarGutter: 'stable' }}`

### Key Considerations

* **Existing pattern**: `node-config-panel.tsx` already uses `overflow-y-scroll` + `scrollbarGutter: 'stable'` on TabsContent
* **Browser support**: `scrollbar-gutter: stable` supported in Chrome 94+, Firefox 97+, Safari 17+
* **Two render paths**: StepCreationPanel renders both embedded and in a Name 14 — fix targets inner scroll containers, covering both
* **CSS-only change**: No logic or state changes needed

### Confidence: High

CSS-only fix following an established codebase pattern. No logic changes needed.
